title: Pointer to the properties of [def-pod-conventions]
text:
In the notation of [def-pod-conventions], the following holds. What this assumption still supplies is
therefore the finite-reduction and scalar-extension compatibilities of the
right adjoints, that is the coefficient transport isolated in
[rem-sf-finite-level-comparison-ingredient]; neither the ambient datum nor
the preservation clauses nor their uniformity over the stages are part of it,
[rem-sf-class-adjoint-residue] recording the residue that concerns the
complexes outside the blueprint's class.
